{{Quote|It&hellip;it's a ''wasteland''.|Nomi Sunrider|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
'''Ambria''', also referred to as '''Stenness''',<ref name="TDSS">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> was a great ringed [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="DH8" /><ref name="TotJ3" /> in the [[Ambria system/Legends|Ambria system]], located in the [[Stenness Node]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

Animal life on Ambria included herds of [[Staga/Legends|staga]], small lizards called [[Neek (creature)|neek]]s, and the strange, evil dragons called [[Hssiss]] from [[Lake Natth]], a place strong with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

Ambria was one of the refuges of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] after their loss in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].<ref name="TEA" /> Shortly before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], it was home to the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Thon]]. In [[4004 BBY]], Thon took [[Oss Wilum]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] on Ambria, following the [[Devastation of Ambria|elimination of its life]] by a [[Unidentified Sith sorceress|Sith sorceress]]. In [[3999 BBY]] Thon took [[Nomi Sunrider]] as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] on Ambria. Also, it was the main war machine for the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], creating [[Warship/Legends|warships]] for the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]].

[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] first came to the world in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Following the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|Battle of Ruusan]], Bane trained his apprentice, [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]], on the world until [[990 BBY]]. The two dueled there [[980 BBY|ten years later]], resulting in Bane's death and Zannah's rise as the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].

==History==
===Early History===
{{Quote|Oss Wilum told me you chose this world because the dark side is strong here." <br /> "Yes. There was a great darkness here. I drove it back, into the lake.|[[Nomi Sunrider]] and Master [[Thon]]|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)" />}}
Discovered during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]], Ambria was a mineral-rich world, which boasted several indigenous sentient species, and a wide variety of fauna. Located in the Stenness Node, Ambria along with most of the other worlds in the sector, was considered a lucrative mining world, and it was not long before corporations began to make use of Ambria's vast amount of natural resources. Over time, Ambria caught the attention of the mining experts in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who established bases there to extract the valuable ores and minerals the planet possessed. However, although Ambria had a breathable atmosphere and plenty of potential nourishment, few permanent establishments were ever built. This was because most species found the terrain too rugged and the climate unbearable to live in, as well as the fact that there were far easier operations to be set up on nearby planets in the [[Stenness Node|Stenness system]]. Thus, Ambria was never colonized, and, by and large, remained uninhabited for millennia, except for the few native species that roamed the wastelands.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /><ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" />

The world remained unchanged for centuries, until a [[Unidentified Sith sorceress|Sith sorceress]] made Ambria her home. Little was known of her origins, and even her name was lost to history, though her deeds had been recorded by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], and were stored in their great [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|archives]]. She used her [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark powers]] to enslave the native sentients, and used many of the planet's wildlife as war-beasts, aided by the dark side. She began construction of a great black obelisk infused with the dark side; it took her slaves over a century to build it, obsession standing the test of time. Eventually, she had the chance to conduct the Sith ritual the obelisk had been built for. The exact nature of this ritual is unknown, though Jedi scholars were able to make out a basic version of events.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" />

===Destruction of Ambria===
{{Main|Devastation of Ambria}}
The Sorceress was not as powerful as she had believed, and her overconfidence proved her undoing.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /> She called on more power than any individual had ever attempted previously,<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" /> and it proved too complex for her to manage. She released an uncontrolled wave of powerful dark energy on the planet; it destroyed every living thing, aside from the semi-sentient [[Hssiss]], on the planet, which became totally infused with dark side energies.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /><ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" />

Later, some time after the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] of [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], several of the remaining Sith Lords sought refuge on Ambria, where they hid among the dark side energies in order to avoid persecution. They stayed on the planet for many years, until passing into the Force themselves, leaving yet more dark side spirits on Ambria. They remained embedded in the planet itself, preventing anything from growing on the desolate world.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" />

===Thon's arrival===
{{Quote|This world is so bleak, Mistress Nomi. Can such a world really be the home of a great Jedi Master?|[[A-3DO]]|audio=ThonAmbria-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)" />}}
In time, a [[Tchuukthai]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] named [[Thon]] would make the ruined planet of Ambria his home. Little was known of Thon's origins; he was highly secretive and reclusive about where he had learned his vast array of Force abilities. After teaching the other Jedi on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] various powers they had not known previously, Thon departed to find somewhere more secluded and peaceful than the Great Jedi Library to train his students. He began wandering the galaxy aimlessly, letting the Force guide him. Eventually, Thon felt the presence of a number of dark side spirits, way out in the distance beyond his ship's scanners. Thon followed the dark presence until he arrived on Ambria, where he was immediately attacked by the malevolent spirits of the Sith. The Tchuukthai Jedi Master managed to repel them for a time, though soon his stamina became depleted, and he could no longer hold off the dark forces. However, Thon still had a plan, and led the spirits to a [[Lake Natth|lake]]; he swam out to the center of the lake, and allowed the dark spirits to consume him. However, with one final effort, the mysterious Jedi Master ensnared his foes in a wave of light side energy, confining them the murky waters at the bottom of the lake. He dubbed the lake "Natth"&mdash;meaning "cage" in the [[Tchuukthese]] [[Language/Legends|language]]. The sinister spirits were furious, and often possessed the herds of Hssiss which frequented Lake Natth, and attacked any visitors to the planet. Although they had not been completely defeated, the dark side spirits on Ambria had finally been contained.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /><ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" />

Thon set about exploring the rest of the planet, and had several foreign species of animal imported; the Jedi Master wanted to bring about the revival of the desert world. On his travels, he discovered a [[Meditative Canyon|vast canyon]] with a particularly strong connection in the Force. Meditating there in hard times, he encouraged the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light of the Force]] to shine once more on the planet. Thon built a small [[Ambria Jedi Enclave|training compound]] on a broad plain, sparse in luxuries and decoration, where he lived, and, when they eventually came to Ambria, taught his Jedi students.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /> He trained several students on Ambria over a twelve year period, including [[Oss Wilum]], a fast-learning [[Vultan]].<ref name="Saga of Nomi Sunrider" />

In [[3999 BBY]], Wilum had all but completed his training, so Thon had fellow Jedi Master [[Chamma]] send his young apprentice to Ambria to hone his Jedi abilities under Thon's expert tutelage. However, [[Andur Sunrider]] never made it to Ambria. Upon arriving in the Stenness system with his wife [[Nomi Sunrider|Nomi]] and daughter [[Vima Sunrider|Vima]], Andur was attacked by thugs sent by Great [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], the self-titled "ruler" of Stenness Node. Bogga had learned that Sunrider would be carrying an amount of valuable [[Adegan crystal/Legends|adegan crystals]], given to him by his Master Chamma as a gift for Thon. Although Bogga's cronies were successful in killing Andur, his wife Nomi, a Force-sensitive being herself, lashed out with her late husband's lightsaber, killing one of Bogga's men. The others fled, and Bogga's efforts to steal the crystals had been thwarted. Nomi continued on to see Thon regardless of Andur's death, and when the Tchuukthai Jedi Master realized her Force potential, he decided to train her in the ways of the Force.<ref name="Saga of Nomi Sunrider" /> Despite the set back, Bogga was still determined to get his hands on the crystals, and sent a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] named [[Finhead Stonebone]] to Ambria to retrieve them and kill Thon. The Tchuukthai managed to halt Stonebone's first assault, but in an effort to make Sunrider use her lightsaber, he gave himself up to the band of pirates without a fight. Nomi had previously killed a man with her late husband's saber, so was reluctant to take a hold of such a potentially dangerous weapon. Thon allowed the pirates to shackle him, though a fight soon broke out between the pirates over who would present the adegan crystals to Great Bogga. Sunrider used this opportunity to use her [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]], an old Jedi art which influenced and affect the actions of others. While Stonebone's crew fought amongst themselves, Nomi rescued Thon, and together they drove back the pirates.<ref name="Saga of Nomi Sunrider" />

[[File:LakeNatth.jpg|thumb|220px|[[Lake Natth]] on Ambria]]

Soon after Sunrider finished her training, the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] broke out between the Jedi Order/Republic and the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]]; Thon was the only remaining inhabitant for the duration of the war. However, several other Jedi, fighting for both sides, visited Ambria midway throughout the war. Sunrider and [[Sylvar]], a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] Jedi, came to see Thon, while another Cathar, named [[Crado]], as well as Thon's former apprentice Oss Wilum, arrived on Ambria to kill the Master. They had been infected by [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], and his lies and propaganda, and had been sent to the barren world to dispose of Thon. The Tchuukthai Master, however, and his two visitors easily defeated the Hssiss, Crado, and Wilum sent after them, and forced the Cathar Dark Jedi into fleeing, while Wilum was eventually redeemed.<ref name="TOTJTSW4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 4]]</ref>

There was little activity on Ambria for the remainder of Thon's life, and after the Jedi Master's death it was left completely uninhabited once again.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

===After Thon===
Although Thon had passed away, his efforts in restoring Ambria's once luscious landscape were making progress, though the spirits remained trapped in Lake Natth. After the Tchuukthai's time, several Jedi would travel there to find solace, though due to the ever increasing amount of crime in the system, it was largely avoided.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slicer/Legends|Slicer]] acquired the access codes for a military base on Ambria and put them up for sale.<ref name="Mission" />

A [[Battle of Ambria|battle]] was fought between the Republic and Sith troops on Ambria during the [[New Sith Wars]] sometime between [[2000 BBY/Legends|2000]] and [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Each faction suffered heavy losses during the battle, with various debris and shrapnel all that remained. Apart from the occasional scavengers, nobody had bothered to clean up the remains, leaving much evidence of the battle even years later. Some time after the battle had ceased, a healer named [[Caleb]] made Ambria his home, determined to mend the wounds of war.<ref name="Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

Approximately one thousand years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] visited Ambria. Bane thought he was going to meet [[Githany]], a member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]], to arrange his rejoining of the Order, though in truth she had been sent to kill Bane. When the Sith arrived on Ambria's surface, he noticed the strength of the dark side coming from Lake Natth, and set up camp there. Githany poisoned Bane with [[Synox/Legends|synox]] when she arrived, and the Sith Lord was left to search for a cure on the barren world of Ambria. He chanced upon two scavenger children and their father. He slaughtered both of the children with his lightsaber, using their father's sorrow to temporarily cleanse himself of the poison. Bane eventually found the healer named Caleb, and threatened to kill his daughter if he would not heal the Sith Lord. Permanently healed, Bane left Ambria, and it was once again largely uninhabited, bar the few scavengers attempting to find value in the remains of the battle fought on the planet previously.<ref name="Path of Destruction" />

===Great Peace of the Republic===
During the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] in [[990 BBY]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Bane returned to Ambria and took up residence near Lake Natth and not far from the Meditative Canyon. He set up a small camp for himself and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. The accommodations were meager, but sufficient enough to serve as both a training ground for Zannah, and a base of operations for Bane, as well as a home of sorts for both.<ref name="RoT" />

The two eventually abandoned the camp for more luxurious locales as the Jedi Order stopped looking for Sith; for they were sure the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were extinct. Traveling the galaxy together, the Force would again draw them to Ambria, though not as Master and apprentice. Zannah lured her teacher to the world and challenged him to a [[Duel on Ambria (980 BBY)|duel]], one that she was sure she would win. Drawing on all her dark side energy, she ravaged Bane's body as he attacked her. As the battle neared to a close, Bane's attempt to possess the girl back-fired; destroying his body and leaving Zannah victorious.<ref name="Dynasty of Evil">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref>

===Imperial Period and beyond===
By the time of the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Ambria had long been forgotten. However, the planet would regain some interest during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

At some point, [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]] established a campus on the planet where they performed research until it was raided by Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Marl Semtin/Legends|Marl Semtin]].<ref name="H1:XWRS" />

==Inhabitants==
Ambria originally had several species, though no major settlements were ever known to have been built by these species. After its natural resources were discovered by the Republic, teams of miners inhabited Ambria, though no permanent settlements were ever established. After the Sith sorceress wiped out the native species, Ambria was left uninhabited, though during Thon's time, many Jedi students lived and trained there.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" /> After the Battle of Ambria, many scavengers made the barren world their home, hoping to scrape a living by searching the remains of the battle for anything of value. Around the time Darth Bane visited Ambria, many families had established homes there, including Caleb and his daughter.<ref name="Path of Destruction" /> In later eras, it remained largely uninhabited, though many Jedi sought refuge on Ambria during the Great Jedi Purge.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

After the cataclysm caused by the Sith sorceress, most of the fauna native to Ambria was killed, with only several breeds of reptile surviving. The savage predators who frequented Lake Natth, the Hssiss, were often possessed by the dark spirits confined to the lake, and were said to aid those who wielded the dark side of the Force. They originated on Ambria, though Bogga the Hutt eventually transported them off-world, using them as guard beasts. Another surviving species were the territorial [[Neek (creature)|neek]]s, who congregated in flocks in an attempt to achieve safety from predators like the Hssiss. Master Thon brought a third species to Ambria, known as [[Staga/Legends|staga]]. Staga were large horned reptiles who moved in herds, and lived outside Thon's dwelling.<ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" />

==Locations==
===Lake Natth===
{{Main|Lake Natth}}

===Meditative Canyon===
{{Main|Meditative Canyon}}

[[File:MeditativeCanyon-PotJ.jpg|thumb|left|255px|A cross-section view of the Meditative Canyon on Ambria.]]

Located in the [[Tiernvael Mountains]], the Meditative Canyon on Ambria was a place with a strong connection to the Force. The area was drier and more barren than the rest of the planet, and because of the relentless wind storms that plagued the region, the Canyon remained largely unexplored for millennia&mdash;even the Sith Sorceress had not discovered it. Master Thon stumbled upon it as he sought shelter during a vicious storm while he traveled around the planet, and found that one of the walls had an unusually powerful presence in the Force; it made the Tchuukthai Master feel calm and cut off from the carnage happening above ground. The ancient Jedi Master left once the storm had subsided, though he marked its location, and often returned to meditate.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

The canyon was extremely vast, measuring over one kilometer deep, one kilometer long and half a kilometer wide. The inside walls of the canyon were lined with small caves, and a deep river lay at the pit of the canyon, twisting and turning to match the canyon's remarkable shape. Along the walls of the canyon and inside the caves, there were a great many stalagmites, some of which were covered in transparent crystals. Though the crystals had no impact on the Force, Thon, and other Jedi, used them to focus on during meditation. The canyon had several levels, each marked with a different strata&mdash;some had ledges and cliffs, while others had massive caves and tunnels. Throughout Ambria's history, none attempted to properly explore these rock formations.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

Despite its connection to the Force, the canyon remained largely devoid of living beings throughout its history. During Thon's time on Ambria, the only creatures who ever explored the canyon were neeks and staga, apart from the Jedi Master and his apprentices. After Thon's time, many Jedi Masters used the canyon to occasionally escape their stressful existence, and during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], it served as an excellent hideout for renegade Jedi&mdash;Emperor Palpatine was unaware of its existence.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

===Sith Obelisk===
{{Main|Ambria Sith obelisk}}
The Sith Obelisk on Ambria was kilometers high, with a large spike that shot up into the sky. Built using much of the natural resources of Ambria, the Obelisk was a dark shade of black in color. It was constructed by the Sith Sorceress's slaves, and took over one hundred standard years to be entirely built. The Obelisk was erected in the wild, northern regions of the planet, near the great canyon discovered by Thon. When the Sorceress' failed ritual destroyed the planet, the Obelisk was destroyed, as were the Sorceress and her slaves.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" /><ref name="Tales of the Jedi Companion" />

===Other locations===
{{Main|Thon's Jedi Training Compound|Ambrian Wastes|Tiernvael Mountains}}

Ambria included many other notable locations, though they were never fully explored and information about them was rare. After arriving on Ambria, Master Thon built a simple house where he trained his students. It contained few possessions or items of comfort, as was the Jedi way. Thon slept on a straw bed on the floor, while visitors had a mattress bed slightly elevated off the ground.<ref name="Saga of Nomi Sunrider" /> Another location was the Ambrian Wastes, a huge desert covering over half the planet. The Tiernvael Mountains were huge, steep mountains shrouded in shadow and darkness, located just north of the Ambrian equator. They were largely unexplored, though the canyon they were located next to was often used by Master Thon for meditation.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Ambria_FF11.jpg|thumb|right|Ambria sans rings]]

In ''[[Tales of the Jedi 4]]'', [[Oss Wilum]] erroneously refers to Ambria as "[[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]" in one panel.<ref name="TotJ4">[[Tales of the Jedi 4|''Tales of the Jedi'' 4]]</ref>

''[[Star Wars Insider 26]]'' mentioned that Ambria was located in the "[[Stenness Node|Stenness systems]]". The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] placed Ambria in the [[Xappyh sector/Legends|Xappyh sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], while the ''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]'' placed the world in the [[Ambria system/Legends|"Stennes" [sic] system]].
